questions.question:
In the given figure, ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral whose side AB is a diameter of the circle through A, B, C and D. If ∠ADC = 130°, then find ∠CAB.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04bfd78e02bb8af9d9808a804ad96e48e71f7a8748e6419e736656fd52b9ff96.png]
questions.solution:
Given :

In a cylic quadrilateral ABCD.

∠ADC = 130°

Concepts Used :

• The sum of the opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral is supplementary i.e. 180º.

• The angle at the circumference in a semicircle is always 90°

Solution :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04bfd78e02bb8af9d9808a804ad96e48e71f7a8748e6419e736656fd52b9ff96.png] 

We know that :

∠ADC + ∠ABC = 180º

∴ ∠ABC = 180º - 130°

⇒ ∠ABC = 50°

We also know that :

• ∠ACB = 90º

Now in ΔABC :

Sum of all interior angles of a triangle = 180º

∠ABC + ∠ACB + ∠CAB = 180º

∠CAB + 50º + 90º = 180º

∠CAB = 180º - 50º - 90º

∠CAB = 40º

Hence the correct answer is "40º".

Therefore, 

∠ADB + ∠BDP = 180∘

⇒ 90∘ + ∠BDP = 180∘

The angle subtended by an arc at the centre is twice that of the angle subtended by it at any point on the remaining part of the circumference of the circle.

Therefore,

⇒ ∠DOC = 2 × ∠DBC

⇒ 60∘ = 2 × ∠DBC

**∴ The value of the required angle is 60∘.**

 IJ is extended up to M and N on both sides

so, ∠LIJ = 180° - 78°

Again,

Now,

So,

questions.question: A quadrilateral ABCD is inscribed in a circle such that the ∠ACD = 35∘ and base AB is diameter to the circle. Find ∠DAB.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A quadrilateral ABCD is inscribed in a circle such that the ∠ACD = 35∘.

**Concept used:**

(1) The angle subtended by the diameter of the circle at any point on the circumference is 90∘.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b698726c1961247a72137e36f03d1162d4e3f1c132d6f6c63ca2325f8bb1ec8c.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/066439f51e5a12a8f6514500f57de0549230100cc1aa512cef45168b1066a700.png] 

Since the angle subtended by the diameter of the circle at any point on the circumference is 90∘,

Therefore, 

⇒ ∠ACB = 90∘

Now, 

⇒ ∠ DCB = ∠ACD + ∠ACB 

⇒ ∠ DCB = 35∘ + 90∘

⇒ ∠ DCB = 125∘

Since the sum of the opposite angle to a quadrilateral is 180∘,

Therefore, 

⇒ ∠DAB + ∠DCB = 180∘

⇒ ∠DAB + 125∘ = 180∘

⇒ ∠DAB = 55∘

The required image:

**∴ The required answer is 55∘.**

questions.question: In a cyclic quadrilateral PQRS, if PQ ∥ RS and ∠P = 85° then ∠Q =
questions.solution:
**Given:**

PQ ∥ RS

∠P = 85°

**Concept used:**

The sum of the interior angles on the same side of a transversal line is always 180 degrees.

The sum of opposite angles in a cyclic quadrilateral is 180°.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da7a3bc4dc64e8c133eb88213c7b76f973e8121c1e06ec8c64c0695666f1bf53.png] 

In a cyclic quadrilateral PQRS.

∠P = 85°

The sum of opposite angles in a cyclic quadrilateral is 180°.

∠P + ∠R = 180° 

⇒ ∠R = 180° - ∠P

⇒ ∠R = 180° - 85°

⇒ ∠R = 95°

Now, ∠Q = 180° - ∠R

⇒ ∠Q = 180° - 95° 

⇒ ∠Q = 85° 

**∴ The correct answer is 85°.**

questions.question: The sides AB and DC of a cyclic quadrilateral ABCD are produced to meet at E and the sides AD and BC are produced to meet at F. If ∠AFB = 52° and ∠FBE = 102°, then what is the measure of ∠BEC?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sides AB and DC of a cyclic quadrilateral ABCD are produced to meet at E and the sides AD and BC are produced to meet at F.

∠AFB = 52° and ∠FBE = 102°,

**Concept used:**

In the case of a cyclic quadrilateral, the value of the interior angle is equal to the opposite exterior angle.

The sum of all internal angles of a triangle is 180∘.

**Calculation:**

According to the question, the required figure is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd8b19095c4f7ae8ad7f444442a99c4180e816053f562b072bc3b472552a10d3.png] 

The value of the interior angle is equal to the opposite exterior angle.

⇒ ∠ ADC = ∠ CBE = 102∘

The value of a straight angle is 180∘.

∠ ADC + ∠ CDF = 180∘

⇒ 102∘ + ∠ CDF = 180∘ 

⇒ ∠ CDF = 78∘ 

In ΔCDF,

∠ CDF + ∠ FCD + ∠ DFC = 180∘ 

⇒ 78∘ + ∠ FCD + 52∘ = 180∘ 

⇒ ∠ FCD + 130∘ = 180∘ 

⇒ ∠ FCD = 50∘ 

As we know, vertically opposite angle are equal.

So,

∠ BCE = ∠ FCD = 50∘ 

In Δ BEC,

∠ BEC + ∠ BCE + ∠ EBC = 180∘

⇒ ∠ BEC + 50∘ + 102∘ = 180∘

⇒ ∠ BEC + 152∘ = 180∘

⇒ ∠ BEC = 28∘

∴** The value of the required angle is 28∘. **
